title: Hot Crispy Gujarati Sevai Grill
description: Salty, springy grilled sevai seasoned with Gujarati spices, perfect for monsoon days.
instructions: Heat an iron teppan over medium heat and lightly oil it with a paper towel.
In a bowl mix 200g sevai, 1 tbsp ground flaxseed, 1 tsp amchur powder, 1 tsp chili powder, and 1 tsp salt.
Toss the sevai in 1 tbsp of oil until coated and set aside to dry slightly.
Sprinkle 1 tsp ground coriander and 1/2 tsp black pepper over the coated sevai and mix well.
Place the seasoned sevai in a single layer on the teppan and press gently with a spatula.
Grill for 4 minutes on one side until golden and crispy, then flip and grill the other side for 3 minutes.
Remove the sevai and toss with freshly squeezed juice from one lemon and finely chopped garlic.
Serve hot with a side of chopped green chili and fresh coriander leaves.
